sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "budget"."School_id" AS e, AVG((CAST(("budget"."total_budget_percent_invested" - "budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted") AS REAL) / "budget"."total_budget_percent_budgeted")) AS m1, COUNT(*) AS m2 FROM "budget" GROUP BY "budget"."School_id"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m2") AS v FROM "s1") SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."m1" AS m1, "s1"."m2" AS m2, (CAST("s1"."m2" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m3 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m3 DESC LIMIT 10
quantities: budget.relative difference of invested share of total budget from budgeted share of total budget
why: (invested share of total budget - budgeted share of total budget) / budgeted share of total budget: the relative difference of two quantities in percent
average of relative difference of invested share of total budget from budgeted share of total budget per School (by School_id)
share of the all total of number of budget records (all level)
